The Trust Problem in Bangladesh Commerce

Without proper verification, both buyers and sellers face real risks every day

Fraud Risk

Fake sellers take advance payments and disappear. Fake buyers waste time with no real intention to purchase.

Trust Resets

When you move to a new platform or area, you start from zero. Your reputation doesn't travel with you.

No Verification

Anyone can create multiple fake profiles. There's no way to know if someone is who they claim to be.

One Trust Profile. Works Everywhere.

Build verified trust through real work confirmations and fair dispute resolution

Verified Identity

National ID and phone verification ensures every profile represents a real person or business.

Verified Work

Work confirmations from real customers build your reputation over time with evidence-based trust.

Dispute Behavior

Fair dispute resolution builds credibility. How you handle conflicts matters more than perfect ratings.

Portable Trust Link

Share your public trust profile anywhere—Facebook, WhatsApp, or print it as a QR code.

How AmrAstha Works

Three simple steps to build portable trust that follows you everywhere

1

Verify Identity

Submit your Bangladesh National ID and phone number. We verify you are a real person or business.

2

Record Work Events

After completing work, request one-tap confirmation from your customer. Build verified work history over time.

3

Share Trust Link

Buyers can check your trust profile in any browser—no app installation needed. Works on Facebook, WhatsApp, anywhere.

Why AmrAstha is Trustworthy

Evidence-Based Confirmations

Trust is built through real work confirmations from verified customers, not anonymous reviews.

Diversity Requirement

Trust comes from varied customers over time, not just friends or family reviews.

Time-Based Growth

Real trust takes time. Consistent work history over months proves reliability better than sudden spikes.

No Public Shaming

We focus on building trust, not destroying reputations. Disputes are handled fairly and privately.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about AmrAstha

No, AmrAstha is not a marketplace. It's trust infrastructure that works with any platform—Facebook, WhatsApp, or direct sales. Think of it as your portable reputation that follows you everywhere.
Unlike public star ratings that can be manipulated, AmrAstha focuses on verified work confirmations and time-based consistency. We don't show public ratings—instead, we show evidence of real work and fair dispute resolution.
No, buyers can view your public trust profile link in any web browser—no app installation required. This makes it perfect for sharing on Facebook, WhatsApp, or even as a QR code on business cards.
We verify your Bangladesh National ID and phone number to ensure every profile represents a real person or business. This prevents fake profiles and builds foundational trust.
Disputes are handled fairly with both parties presenting their side. How you handle conflicts actually builds trust—fair resolution shows you're a professional. We don't allow public shaming or permanent black marks.
